punchline: An overweight night-shift exterminator lost over 100 pounds in under three months to qualify for Navy SEAL training.
thirty_sec: In Can't Hurt Me, David Goggins describes a painful childhood and a stuck young adulthood: nearly 300 pounds, working nights as an exterminator. After watching a documentary on SEAL training, he decided to become one and lost over 100 pounds in under three months to qualify. His key tool was the Accountability Mirror: sticky notes naming his goals and insecurities, faced honestly every morning.
question: What would you write on your own accountability mirror?
